title: Mouth In
description: A mouth in camera move enters speech or appetite until lips and teeth become the set. The camera travels past the portrait into the orifice as landscape.

sections.title: Narrative function

blocks.text: Speech or hunger is the scene. A threat spoken, a kiss that should feel like a location, a bite that is architecture: the mouth is not a detail in a portrait.
Eating zoom is the comic, food-first version of the same aggression. A random gore insert is not this shot unless the film has already made the mouth a room.
Keep the rest of the body out.

sections.title: How it works

blocks.text: Prompt a push into the mouth, lips as foreground, interior as arrival. One move.
Light the teeth like architecture. Do not also rack focus or whip-pan.
Prompt: Mouth-in move on [Subject], the camera entering speech or appetite, lips as landscape.

sections.title: What usually goes wrong

blocks.text: The usual wrong cousin is a face with an open mouth. The tell: a portrait, teeth visible, camera never arriving inside.
The fix: end past the lips, teeth as architecture, no leftover MCU.

sections.title: Questions

blocks.text: What is Mouth In in film?
Mouth in is a camera move that enters the mouth until lips and teeth become the set. Speech or appetite is treated as a location.
Mouth In vs Eating Zoom
Mouth in travels into the orifice as landscape. Eating zoom is a snap into the bite, with food or a utensil as the last foreground.
When should I use Mouth In?
Use it when speech, hunger, or a kiss should feel like a place. Do not use it as a random shock insert.
How do I prompt Mouth In for AI image or video?
Write a push that ends past the lips. Example: Mouth-in move on [Subject], the camera entering speech or appetite, lips as landscape.
